rootNote: Teaching root by convention (GKC/Davidson). The verb itself is rare in the Bible (Job 13:15; 24:14; Ps 139:19), so example words come from other roots in the same slot.
source: Written from standard grammar conventions (Gesenius-Kautzsch-Cowley, Davidson, Kelley, Pratico-Van Pelt, K&J). Not copied from any chart.
verificationMethod: Each form was matched (consonants + vowel points, accents ignored, dagesh lene and plene/defective holam, shureq and ḥireq-yod spellings normalized) against OSHB morphhb-wlc tokens with the same OSHB morph slot (e.g. HVqp3ms). The example's root was checked against the Strong's headword for its lemma number. Ketiv tokens are excluded. Example preference: strong root with no prefix, then strong root with ו prefix, then a root with a guttural or nun radical whose vowel pattern is identical.
oshbPin: morphhb-wlc as used in haday-hebrew-data v1.2.0 (OSHB 3d15126)

fields.status: attested-example | paradigm-standard (no clean attestation in WLC for this slot; the form is the standard grammar form)
fields.exampleRootClass: strong | guttural-or-nun (root has a guttural or nun radical but the vowel pattern is identical)

notes.cohortative: Cohortative = 1st-person yiqtol + ָה (Qal אֶקְטְלָה, נִקְטְלָה). Shown as a note, not a separate table row.
notes.jussive: In the strong verb the jussive looks the same as yiqtol in every binyan except Hiphil (יַקְטֵל vs יַקְטִיל).
notes.Hophal imperative: Not part of the standard paradigm. WLC tags only two Hophal imperatives: Ezek 32:19 וְהָשְׁכְּבָה and Jer 49:8 הָפְנוּ (neither is a plain strong-verb form).

cells.note: An אִקָּטֵל spelling also occurs (see alternates).
Grammars differ: תִּקָּטַלְנָה vs תִּקָּטֵלְנָה. WLC evidence: see VERIFY-REPORT.
Two standard types: נִקְטֹל and הִקָּטֵל.
3ms also occurs with pataḥ (קִטַּל); see alternates.
Yod with vocal shewa does not take the doubling dagesh after wa-.
Hiphil is the one strong-verb binyan whose jussive differs visibly from yiqtol.
First vowel is qameṣ ḥaṭuf (short o); WLC writes it with ordinary qameṣ U+05B8. Also הֻקְטַל.
Prefix vowel is qameṣ ḥaṭuf; also written with qibbuṣ (יֻקְטַל).
